title: ONLY MACHINES ARE GOLDEN
why: His words 10-31: there should not be golden pillager bots, pillager bots are meant to replicate live players since we will take the game online eventually. The golden enemy is now picked only from machines (crawler, sentry, bulwark, howler, listener); no pillager of any kind is ever gilded. The pick stays on its own side stream, only the candidate list shrank, so the seed 4242 fingerprint holds; a raid with no machine far enough away has no golden enemy. RULE FOR LATER: pillager bots stand in for live players, so they get no boss-style buffs. The bounty pillager raid event is not part of this order and is left alone (logged as a question).
now: Only machines are golden. The golden enemy is never a pillager. WATCH: a raid where the golden enemy is always a machine; if a raid has none far enough away, no golden enemy that raid.
